suppressedAutomationHostsHelp.message: One hostname per line. The list saves automatically after a short pause while typing, or when you press Save — important because the popup closes when you click outside it. On these hosts, heavy page scripts and the in-page "save new password" banner are skipped; you can still copy credentials from the popup. On other sites, if "Prompt to save password" is on (admin allows), the extension can offer to store new logins after you sign in.

suppressedAutomationHostsIntro.message: Domains or IPs where field scanning, autofill injection, and save prompts are skipped — useful on slow dashboards or self-hosted apps.
